Metadata.title: Scout — Identify an item, find where to buy it cheaper
Metadata.description: A browser extension and dashboard that identify clothing or sneakers from a photo and find where to buy them cheaper, in the right size.

service.heading: The service
service.body: Scout identifies clothing or sneakers from a photo and finds matching products across different merchants, along with their prices. Scout doesn't sell any product directly — every purchase happens on the merchant's own site, outside of Scout.

accuracy.heading: Accuracy of information
accuracy.body: Prices, availability, and product matches come from third-party services (visual search and product search) and are provided for guidance only. Scout doesn't guarantee their accuracy or availability at the time of purchase on the merchant's site.

subscriptions.heading: Subscriptions
subscriptions.item1: The free tier allows a limited number of scans, with no commitment.
subscriptions.item2: Paid tiers (Discovery, Essential, Pro) are billed monthly via Stripe and can be cancelled at any time from the subscription management area, with no notice period or cancellation fees.
subscriptions.item3: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid for — no prorated refund for the current month.

usage.heading: Permitted use
usage.body: The service is intended for personal use identifying items and comparing prices. Any abusive automated use, attempt to circumvent account limits, or upload of unlawful content is prohibited and may result in account suspension.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: Scout is provided "as is". We do our best to keep the service reliable but cannot guarantee continuous availability or the absence of identification errors.

law.heading: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by French law.

confidentialite.title: Privacy Policy
confidentialite.draftNoticeExtra: Working draft — needs a professional review before going live, especially for full GDPR compliance and the publisher identification details (business registration number, address) once the company is officially registered.

publisher.heading: Publisher
publisher.body: Scout is published by [Name / company name to be completed], [address to be completed], [registration number to be completed]. Contact: [contact email to be completed].

dataCollected.heading: Data collected
dataCollected.item1: Email address and account information (managed by Clerk).
dataCollected.item2: Images you upload or link for identification — hosted temporarily to allow analysis.
dataCollected.item3: History of your scans, saved items, and target prices set.
dataCollected.item4: Payment information when subscribing — handled directly by Stripe, Scout never has access to your card number.

subprocessors.heading: Subprocessors and third-party services
subprocessors.intro: Some data passes through third-party providers necessary for the service to run:
subprocessors.item4: SerpApi — searching for matching products and their prices.
subprocessors.item5: Vercel — site hosting and temporary image storage (Vercel Blob).

rights.heading: Your rights (GDPR)
rights.body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting us at [contact email to be completed]. Deleting your account also deletes your scan history and wishlist.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: Scout uses a session cookie (managed by Clerk) required to stay signed in to your account. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used today.
